name: alert
title: Alert
description: A versatile alert component with multiple variants (filled, light, lighter, stroke), status colors (error, warning, success, information, feature), and sizes. Uses namespace exports: Alert.Root, Alert.Icon, Alert.CloseIcon.

migration.guide: API changed: import as namespace `import * as Alert from ...`, use `<Alert.Root variant="filled" status="error">` instead of `<Alert variant="errorFilled">`. Variant and status are now separate props. Sub-components: `Alert.Icon` (polymorphic), `Alert.CloseIcon`. Old `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `AlertActions`, `AlertLink`, `AlertButton` sub-components removed. Dependencies changed from `cva` + `react-icons` to `tv` + `@remixicon/react`. Old `alert-utils.ts` is no longer included.

docs.lead: A versatile alert component with multiple variants, status colors, and sizes for user notifications.
docs.usage:
import * as Alert from "@/components/ui/alert"

<Alert.Root variant="filled" status="error">
  <Alert.Icon />
  Insert your alert title here!
</Alert.Root>

examples.title: Default Icons
examples.description: Each status automatically renders a matching icon: error (RiErrorWarningFill), warning (RiAlertFill), success (RiCheckboxCircleFill), information (RiInformationFill), feature (RiSparklingFill). No `as` prop needed.
examples.code:
<Alert.Root variant="light" status="error">
  <Alert.Icon />
  Error alert
</Alert.Root>

<Alert.Root variant="light" status="success">
  <Alert.Icon />
  Success alert
</Alert.Root>

examples.title: Custom Icon
examples.description: Override the default icon using the `as` prop.
examples.code:
<Alert.Root variant="light" status="feature">
  <Alert.Icon as={RiMagicFill} />
  Feature alert with custom icon
</Alert.Root>

api.name: Alert.Icon
api.description: Renders a status icon. Defaults to a matching icon per status (error → RiErrorWarningFill, warning → RiAlertFill, success → RiCheckboxCircleFill, information → RiInformationFill, feature → RiSparklingFill). Override with the `as` prop.

props.name: as
props.description: Override the default status icon with a custom icon component

api.name: Alert.CloseIcon
api.description: Renders a close/dismiss icon. Defaults to RiCloseLine.

props.name: as
props.description: Override the default close icon component
